availability_rules.CLOSE_OCCASION: unstamped row, emitted_on in {SEGMENT_CLOSE, STREAM_END}: withheld from every group; released after exhaustion
availability_rules.EMITTED_AT_RECV_NS: the row's own emitted_at_recv_ns (native_clocks.LIFECYCLE_AVAILABILITY_STAMP), the receive instant the driver retained it at; read FIRST, integers only
availability_rules.LEGACY: ts_recv (float seconds) <= cutoff_ns / 1e9, the adapter's own arithmetic
availability_rules.NO_OWN_CLOCK: unstamped row naming no receive clock: withheld and counted, never dropped
availability_rules.OWN_CLOCK: the latest integer recv_ns / *_recv_ns the row names at any depth
availability_rules.SECOND_COMPLETE: (second + 1) * 1e9 on the row's declared ts_recv_ns clock

falsifier_f20.rule: PASS iff the whole stream was consumed with a lifecycle ledger supplied and withheld_no_own_clock and withheld_close_occasion both total zero
